  context={"endpoint"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Records the carrier's latest estimated arrival on a `BOOKED` appointment. An `etaAt` later than `windowStart` plus the
site's arrival tolerance raises the advisory `DockAppointmentAtRisk` (analytics stream) once per report; nothing is
rescheduled automatically. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`.
